title: Career Roadmap · IT Support
summary: An IT Support professional installs, maintains and troubleshoots computers, software, networks, user accounts and workplace technology systems.

facts.Course: Diploma - Cyber Security / AI / Data Analytics / Cloud

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science with Mathematics is useful, but many diploma and entry-level IT support pathways accept other streams.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Computer Science, Mathematics, English and basic electronics.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Computer hardware, operating systems, networking and cybersecurity fundamentals.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Troubleshooting, logical thinking, documentation and customer communication.

blocks.label: Entrance
blocks.text: Polytechnic diploma admissions and private training eligibility vary by state and institution; verify current notifications.

items.text: Diploma in Computer Engineering / IT → Hardware, software and technical support.
Diploma in Networking / Cybersecurity → Network troubleshooting and security support.
BCA → Operating systems, programming and IT operations.
B.Sc. Computer Science / IT → Systems support and technical roles.
B.Tech. Computer Science / IT → Broader systems, networks, cloud and infrastructure pathways.

blocks.label: India admission routes
blocks.text: State polytechnic admission processes for diploma programmes; relevant university or entrance processes for degree programmes. Requirements vary by course.
Government / Public

items.text: Government Polytechnic, Vijayawada — investigate Computer Engineering / IT diploma offerings.
Andhra Polytechnic, Kakinada — investigate current computer-related diploma offerings.
Government Polytechnic, Visakhapatnam — verify current computer-related programmes.
NIT Warangal — B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering.
University College of Engineering, Osmania University, Hyderabad — engineering and computing programmes.

blocks.text: Private

items.text: VIT, Vellore — computer science programmes.
SRM Institute of Science and Technology — computing and IT programmes.
Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham — computer science and engineering.
Manipal Institute of Technology — computing and IT programmes.
KL University, Andhra Pradesh — computing and engineering programmes.

blocks.text: These are options to investigate, not a ranking. For an entry-level IT support career, a relevant diploma plus practical lab experience may be sufficient; verify programme availability and admission rules on official sites.

blocks.text: Ask about merit-based and need-based assistance.

Eligibility depends on income, category, domicile, course and institution. No universal percentage cutoff applies; verify current official notification.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Computer hardware, Windows/Linux basics, troubleshooting and documentation.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Networking, user accounts, backups, cybersecurity basics and practical labs.

blocks.label: Year 3 / work experience
blocks.text: Ticketing systems, remote support, cloud basics and internships.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Build and troubleshoot a PC; create a small office network; configure user permissions and backups; set up an IT help-desk ticket workflow.

blocks.label: Government / education
blocks.text: College IT departments, public-sector IT teams and eligible technical training programmes.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Managed service providers, IT support vendors, corporate IT departments and computer service centres.

blocks.label: Ideal areas
blocks.text: Desktop support, hardware repair, help desk, network support and device administration.

blocks.label: Official training example
blocks.text:
NIELIT’s PC Hardware & Networking course covers installation, troubleshooting and maintenance for technical-support-related roles.
NIELIT
+1
Internships and job placements are not guaranteed.

blocks.text: Diploma → BCA / B.Sc. IT / B.Tech. → broader computing roles.

MCA, subject to the programme’s eligibility requirements.

blocks.text: Common admission requirements

items.text: Academic records and programme-specific prerequisites.
English proficiency where required.
Relevant mathematics or computing subjects for some degrees.
Passport, finances and applicable student-visa documents.

blocks.text: Confirm current programme availability, fees and entry requirements on official institution websites.

blocks.text: IT Support Technician, Service Desk Analyst, Desktop Support Engineer, Junior Systems Administrator.

blocks.label: Typical route

items.text: Direct employment depends on experience, vacancies, employer requirements and local work authorization. Sponsorship is not guaranteed.

blocks.text: IT Student / Trainee ↓ IT Support Technician ↓ Desktop Support / Service Desk Analyst ↓ Senior IT Support Engineer ↓ Systems / Network Administrator ↓ Cloud / Infrastructure / Security Specialist ↓ IT Lead / IT Manager

CLASS 10 / 12 ↓ DIPLOMA IN COMPUTER / IT OR RELATED DEGREE ↓ HARDWARE + OS + NETWORKING SKILLS ↓ PRACTICAL LABS + CERTIFICATION + INTERNSHIP ↓ IT SUPPORT / HELPDESK ROLE ↓ SYSTEMS / NETWORK / CLOUD SPECIALIZATION ↓ SENIOR ENGINEER / IT LEAD
